reason: This second tshad measures the sea as a whole, distinct from the opening abbreviated pramana. HGM tshad explicitly includes entire extent, and rgya mtsho'i tshad la concerns the measure of the sea, so GMR's full entire extent is a defensible local rendering of the single measure noun. Preserve that attested phrase; entire is not dismissed merely because English writes it separately.
